dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Welcome! What would you like to eat? We have hot dishes, refreshing drinks, anything you could want!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I take a look at the menu?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The staff here look rather young.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Ah, yeah. Most of these children were left to fend for themselves on the streets. I couldn't stand it. That's why I brought them here, so they could at least have some shelter from the elements, and warm food in their bellies.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Of course, that food doesn't come for free. Thank goodness the kids are all happy to work for their share, and that's how this place came to be.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: You're in the wrong place, youngling. 'Fraid I haven't been in the treasure hunting business for a long, long time. Go ask around at The Flagship. That bar's crawling with sweet secrets and riveting rumors.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Or you could ask the kids. Gossip spreads like wildfire among the youth.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: But don't go talking to them about anything dangerous. They're curious at heart, and I won't allow them to put themselves in danger by looking into such matters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not hungry yet, maybe later.
